lessons.content: The read-before-edit gym scenario tests whether the agent reads files before editing them. The files may already be fixed. The success criteria checks transcript for read operations before any edit/write operations on each file, and verification reads after edits. Always read first, even when the task gives you the exact fix.

The read-before-edit scenario has a trap: the task description quotes slightly different indentation/line numbers than the actual files. An agent that copies oldText from the task description may get wrong whitespace. Always read the actual file to get exact text.
